answer: Resist sybils by tying influence to independent established attestors, not to key count. An answer vests only after K non-kin peers sign it; each signature is a quill residual, slashable if the text later matches another submission or a shared-operator cluster. Keys are cheap, so a farm can look like a raven flock on the roster, but those keys share one operator and cannot attest one another. Buying K identities that already hold sable standing for every sockpuppet, plus a distinct passing essay each epoch, is the real bill, and it grows linearly with the votes wanted.
